In November 1873, a party of 21 prospectors left Salt Lake City and headed towards the mountains. Two months later, they arrived at the Ute Indian encampment where they were urged to wait out the winter. After two weeks, 6 men including 23-year old Alferd Packer who acted as their guide, decided to try to make it to an Indian agency 75 miles away. 65 days later, only Alferd Packer arrived at the agency. Over a year later the remains of the missing men were found and by now Packer had told two different versions of what had happened. Whether he murdered them all or claimed to have killed only one in self-defense, what he never denied was that he ate one of the men. Since there was no law on the Colorado books for cannibalism, Packer was arrested for first-degree murder. Due to legal technicalities, it would take two trials to convict Packer (of 5 counts of manslaughter) and sentence him to 40 years in prison. In July of 1989, law and forensic Professor James Starrs of George Washington University decided to try to prove which version of Packer’s tale was indeed the true one. He led a team including archaeologists and forensic anthropologists and unearthed the 5 graves. He hoped by studying the bones, the truth of how these men died would finally be revealed. The bones were taken to the anthropology lab at the University of Arizona where forensic anthropologist Dr. Walter Birkby and a small team studied them. With the evidence uncovered from the bones, Starrs concluded that Packer was a murdering cannibal and liar. On this episode of Skeleton Crew, Dr. Elizabeth Murray will re-examine the evidence and documentation taking a closer look at the most recent conclusions of the forensic anthropological studies to see which version of Alferd Packer's story may be closer to the truth.

Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

Blippi wants to find out how awesome things work! He and D.BO visit a construction site where they learn all about safety and how a crane works. Then, they meet Frankie the Firetruck to see all of her amazing fire-fighting abilities in action! After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car and a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. Finally, Blippi shrinks down to see how a guitar makes beautiful music!

Join Cody's Learning Month! Use sign language for 'more' and 'all done,' and celebrate Dino Day with Richard. Form a rock band with friends, solve the mystery of the missing buses, and learn that goodbyes at daycare aren't forever.

JJ is learning all about how to share, help and be kind! First, he learns the magic words 'please' and 'thank you,' and what to do when you make a mistake. The lessons continue as JJ, YoYo and TomTom show how much fun it is to share their snacks and toys. Being kind also means being helpful, and JJ's family loves to help each other around the house. From using good manners at the table to learning how to wait in line, it's a day of learning to be a good friend and family member!

Baby John is learning how to be a great big brother and a good friend! When Mom needs a nap, Jack and Jill decide to help by taking care of their little brother. Then, Baby John learns how to be a friend to everyone by sharing, working together and including everyone in play. Baby John also shows he has a great role model, because he loves his big brother Jack and wants to be just like him, following him around and copying everything he does!

Baby John is learning some very important lessons! First, he refuses to try his veggies and fruits, but Mom finds different ways to convince him after she sees that he'll try them if the other members of the family do it first! Then, Mom helps Baby John get through his morning routine with a fun chart. The important lessons continue as Baby John learns about fire safety with a firefighter and how to stay safe during bathtime.

Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

Arpo and Baby Daniel are causing chaos all over town! The adventure starts at the supermarket when Daniel runs off with a giant lollipop, leading to a wild chase with Arpo's rockets on the fritz. Then, a relaxing fishing picnic turns into a wilderness survival test when a thieving squirrel tries to steal their food! Plus, the family gets a mischievous new puppy that Arpo has to keep from making messes and a stroller goes on the loose, forcing Arpo to chase it through town!

Join Bubbles for a day of magic, a blob, a show and a bubble! First, Bubbles is excited to watch Pogo's magic show, but her curiosity gets the better of her and she spoils his tricks! Then, she invents a brand new bouncy blob, but it bounces out of control and causes havoc all over the Bodpod! The adventures continue as Bubbles gets stage fright before a big show and tries her best to stop a giant, beautiful bubble from popping.

It's a day of learning to play together with blocks, dancing, football and storytime! First, Jeff's neat block towers keep getting knocked over by Bubbles, and they must learn to share their space. Then, Fuse refuses to listen to instructions during a dancing game and has to learn how to work as a team. The lessons continue as Bubbles learns not to cheat to win a football game and Jeff has to decide if he will share his new book during storytime.

There are so many fun things to discover with Mia, Max and their friends! First, they head to the park for some rolling fun as they play Jack and Jill, rolling down the muddy grass and whizzing down the slide! Then, Max gets his first sippy cup and is so excited to show it off that he starts an impromptu tea party with all his playmates. The day of discovery ends with a rainy day competition to see who can make the biggest puddle splash of all!

Go from bathtime to bedtime with Mia and Max! The fun starts with a splashy, bubbly good time as the kids play with their rubber ducks and get nice and clean in the tub. After the bath, it's time to get into pajamas and play a fun game of Peek-a-boo with Mummy using lots of different objects from around the house. Finally, it's time for bed as Daddy and Ella take turns giving Max a cuddle and a teddy bear before he goes to sleep. Night night!

Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

Get ready for a big day of discovery and play with Twinkle and her friends! The fun starts as they learn to play new musical instruments, with Twinkle on drums, Kitty on the sax and Bunny on guitar! Then, it's time to play a fun game of 'Twinkle Says'! Follow along as they give you playful instructions and see if you can keep up. The discoveries continue as the friends find a mirror and make funny faces and wonder what an umbrella is for before it starts to rain!

Join Twinkle for some gentle lessons and soothing bedtime songs. First, Twinkle learns about the importance of eating healthy, delicious fruit, like bananas, oranges and grapes. Then, help her find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck and cow make! After a long day of learning, it's time to get ready for bed. Listen as Twinkle and Mr. Moon sing a soothing nighttime lullaby to help you relax and drift off to sleep.

During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. They find a way to get the twins to work together and splash the Doobydoos with water and wash off the friendship dust. The twins are friends again even though Deedee’s magic didn’t work as expected.

p.t: Royal Documentaries - S01:E38 - HM The Queen A Remarkable Life
p.d: The most notable woman in modern times has to be our Late Queen, Elizabeth II. She ruled for 70 years, the longest reign in British history. Once a princess who wasn't supposed to be queen, Elizabeth II led the country to thrive after World War II and became a steady presence in our changing world. In a thousand years of British monarchy, Elizabeth II is likely one of the most outstanding monarchs ever.
